authority: non-authoritative blind-judge evidence; not verified or human-accepted defect truth
observed_result: In these single low-effort checkpoint-controlled replicates, 4bit/low produced one actionable finding out of three while 8bit/low produced none. Both produced schema-valid, source-grounded reports.
interpretation_ceiling: The actionability rate is a blind-judge proxy, not ground-truth precision. One stochastic replicate with three findings per arm cannot estimate stable precision or recall. The arms selected different third projections, so the result jointly reflects quantization-sensitive reasoning and route selection rather than isolated decoder accuracy.
